note: Select, SelectContainer, SelectOption, SelectDivider, Toggle, RadioGroup and the Stepper parts (StepperContainer, StepperDecreaseButton, StepperIncreaseButton, StepperInput) forward their ref, so a ref reaches the element on React 18 too, where a function component never receives `ref` as a prop. A ref given to Select or SelectContainer no longer replaces the internal one, which outside-click closing and popup positioning rely on. Toggle hands the `role="switch"` element; StepperInput hands the `<input>`, or the `<output>` of a `type="text"` stepper
